items.l1: For them, finishing a race is not only for getting a medal, but even more a confirmation of self-discipline and perseverance.
items.notes: Faithful; low score is synonym variance only (而言/来说, 并非只是/不仅, 确认/肯定).

items.l1: As a result, the system gradually linked "male" with "excellent candidate" and automatically lowered the scores of résumés containing female-related experience.
items.notes: Faithful; variance is 挂钩 vs 联系在一起 and clause order of 对…自动降低评分.

items.l1: What is more troublesome is that most algorithms are like a "black box", and users find it hard to know the basis of their decisions; the lack of transparency lets the problem go unnoticed for a long time.
items.notes: Faithful; troublesome is a standard gloss of 棘手, rest is synonym variance (使用者/用户, 无人察觉/得不到察觉).

items.l1: For many young people, obtaining a driver's license is almost regarded as a necessary rite of passage into adulthood.
items.notes: Faithful; rite of passage into adulthood = 成人仪式, back-translation variance only (必经仪式 vs 必需的成人仪式).

items.l1: For most people, the Spring Festival travel rush is not only a journey but also an arrangement connected with family reunion, so what lies behind grabbing tickets is anticipation of home.
items.notes: Same facts and focus; 承载 is folded into 'lies behind', otherwise synonym variance (旅行/旅程, 期待/期盼).

items.l1: In other words, the reason there are few bullet holes near the engines is not that those spots are hard to hit, but that most aircraft hit there crashed.
items.notes: Faithful; 'hit there' makes explicit what the gold implies, variance is 换言之/换句话说 and 中弹/被击中.

items.l1: So coding summer camps are gradually becoming popular.
items.notes: Faithful; becoming popular admits 受到欢迎 or 流行起来.

items.l1: Those who send red envelopes often have to weigh the amount and the number of people, neither appearing perfunctory nor being so lavish that it makes others feel burdened; those who grab them need to judge the timing, since if the first person to open one says nothing, they will inevitably be seen as rude, and a fitting word of thanks or good wishes is often valued more than the red envelope itself.
items.notes: All clauses present and in order; low score is literary vs plain wording (斟酌/掂量, 拿捏节奏/把握时机, 看重/重视).

items.l1: However, when the dessert arrived, our expectations quietly cooled: it looked beautiful, but the cream was too sweet and cloying, and the base was a little soggy.
items.notes: Same facts; 期待感却悄然降温 and 造型虽美 have several faithful renderings, 'our' is given by the first-person context.

items.l1: On the way home, I pulled up the reviews on my phone and found that beneath the high scores there were also some complaints, with quite a few people complaining about "photos that lie" and poor value for money.
items.notes: Faithful; variance is register (亦有微词 vs 也有一些差评, 性价比失衡 vs 性价比低).

items.l1: But once the time cost of queuing is counted into the bill as well, living up to one's name becomes something quite luxurious.
items.notes: Faithful; 只是当…一并计入…便 vs 但一旦…也算进…就 is connective variance only.

items.l1: This way of making a living does bring freedom of time and low entry barriers, but it also hands the risk of unstable income back to the individual: the number of orders depends entirely on the platform's algorithmic dispatch, and the peak season and the off season are often as different as heaven and earth.
items.notes: Faithful; gold is literary (判若云泥, 订单多寡全凭), and the English idiom equivalent invites 天差地别.

items.l1: Using these analysis results, planning departments can discover which residential areas lack direct services to employment centers and which road sections are congested for long periods, and then add routes, adjust stops or shorten departure intervals in a targeted way.
items.notes: Faithful; shorten intervals = 加密发车间隔 and direct services = 直达班次, variance is lexical.

items.l1: Compensation and resettlement plans do indeed provide material accommodation, but they can hardly take on the feelings attached to specific places.
items.notes: Same facts; 回迁/安置/承接/地点 each have several faithful renderings, and resettlement matches the neighbouring 回迁楼 rendering.

items.l1: Many customers care about putting on a lavish display when ordering, often exceeding what they can actually eat, so that a lot of dishes are left over.
items.notes: 'keeping up appearances' pointed to 讲面子, not 讲究排场 (ostentatious spread); changed to 'putting on a lavish display'.

items.l1: The dog-walking hours in the early morning and at night are precisely when neighbor conflicts are most easily inflamed: barking penetrates thin walls, lapses with the leash let pets startle the elderly and children, and excrement left in stairwells is also a common sight.
items.notes: All three clauses faithful; low score is the gold's literary register (亦, 遗留于, 孩童) that English cannot mark.

items.l1: Such neighbor disputes seem trivial but in fact reflect a lack of residential ethics: pet owners both enjoy the pleasure of companionship and must bear the responsibility of restraint.
items.notes: 'living ethics' widened 居住伦理 to 生活伦理; changed to 'residential ethics', rest unchanged.

items.l1: If every owner could be considerate of other people's expectations of quiet and cleanliness, people and pets could coexist peacefully under the same roof.
items.notes: 'consider' lost the empathy of 体谅 (reads as 顾及/考虑); changed to 'be considerate of'.

items.l1: Father, as usual, occupies the middle of the sofa, while Mother is busy setting melon seeds and tangerines on the coffee table.
items.notes: Faithful; low score is 父亲/母亲 vs 爸爸/妈妈 and 往…摆 vs 在…摆放, both valid.

items.l1: Interestingly, the family's reactions to the same program often differ greatly: Grandmother laughs until she keeps wiping away tears, while I find the lines slightly dated and cannot help grumbling in a low voice on my phone.
items.notes: Faithful; variance is 祖母/奶奶, 陈旧/过时, 低声/小声.

items.l1: However, this meticulous care often turns, without anyone noticing, into heavy pressure: the child fears letting down the parents' sacrifice and also worries that their choices will be repeatedly discussed and revised, until in the end they can hardly even be sure what they like.
items.notes: Faithful; variance is 细致入微的关爱 vs 无微不至的关怀 and 转化为 vs 变成.

items.l1: Only when families learn to restore a score to being just a score, and hand the choice of application back to the child's interests, will that pressure truly loosen.
items.notes: 'Only when…will' renders 当…才会; variance is 还原为 vs 回归 and 志愿 vs 志愿的选择.

items.l1: In the field of business management, there has long been a contest between two orientations in decision-making.
items.notes: Faithful; contest admits 博弈 or 较量, and business management admits 商业管理 or 企业管理.
